    Source-category lifts of BGRS ray paths #

    Choose an ordinary source-category representative for every irreducible arrow of a BGRS ray category and evaluate paths by ordinary composition. For any such choice, every nonzero ray path is represented correctly, and equal nonzero ray paths are exactly those whose ordinary composites differ by endpoint units.

    This file deliberately makes no scalar-normalization claim. Constructing a semi-normalized presentation and annihilating singular paths are separate BGRS inputs.
